title: Quick Reference: Schedule Caps, Reporting Windows and Endorsement Dating by Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Package
content:
The figures below are the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy package figures the policy service desk applies to the vehicle and driver schedule: how many vehicles and rated drivers a policy may carry, the reporting windows for a newly acquired vehicle and a new household driver, how far ahead an endorsement may be dated, and whether the package may be changed during the term.

| Figure | Cardinal Auto Essential | Cardinal Auto Basic | Cardinal Auto Standard | Cardinal Auto Plus | Cardinal Auto Preferred | Cardinal Auto Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Most vehicles scheduled on one policy | 4 | 4 | 6 | 6 | 8 | 8 |
| Most rated (non-excluded) drivers on one policy | 4 | 4 | 6 | 6 | 8 | 8 |
| Newly acquired additional vehicle report window, calendar days after acquisition | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 30 | 30 |
| Household driver report window, calendar days after the member became licensed or moved in | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Furthest an endorsement effective date may be set into the future, calendar days | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Coverage package may be changed during the term | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Notes

- The vehicle cap is per policy and per package; excluded drivers do not count toward the rated-driver cap.
- The newly acquired vehicle window applies to an additional vehicle, not to a replacement. On Cardinal Auto Essential through Cardinal Auto Plus it is 14 calendar days; on Cardinal Auto Preferred and Cardinal Auto Premier it is 30.
- On Cardinal Auto Essential and Cardinal Auto Basic the package cannot be changed during the term; a different package can be chosen only on the renewal offer.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A Cardinal Auto Basic policy already scheduling 4 vehicles is at its cap of 4; a Cardinal Auto Standard policy with 4 vehicles is below its cap of 6.
- An endorsement requested today on any package may be dated today or up to 30 calendar days ahead.
